answer: Stop fake identities with a sunk sybil tax. Each agent pays a non-refundable 40 units to enter, as planting a grove costs labour before any tree yields. A juniper cutting planted cannot be harvested tomorrow, and a paid identity cannot be cloned for free: peers check the receipt first. A walnut grower faking 100 identities pays 4,000 for slots paying 30 each, a net loss of 1,000. One honest agent pays once and keeps its undiluted reward.
